column1: # The clip sweep's EXPLAINED items (docs 6.62): site, kind, reason and optionally the box width in px the explanation is for. site is file:line of the Text in src/slint/ui;
# tools/test_slint_clip_probe.py checks that every site still names a Text, so an edit that moves one makes the sweep report it again instead of silently covering another line.

column3: the digit glow: two rings of faint copies of the numeral are drawn around it, offset on purpose (glow-reach); they are light, not text anyone reads, and the numeral itself is inside its box
a Key given less than its label asks for (an explicit width, a fixed cell): Key.squeezed puts the label in the tip before the tooltip (test_slint_elided)
a RailKey caption longer than the 64 px rail: caption-elided puts the caption in the tip before the tooltip (test_slint_elided)

the receiver strip's antenna-power caption in its 120 px lane: the caption has a tip of its own (main.slint antenna-caption; NOT exercised by a hover test - it is the same TouchArea and TipTimer pair as the tested ones). The toolbar's Trace and Range captions hide themselves when squeezed (visible binding) and are not reported
a status chip's detail: a chip squeezed by a long language gives up its detail first (StatusChip, main.slint) and its tooltip is the whole detail (tooltip: c.detail, which predates this change)
a SelectKey value longer than its key: value-elided puts the value in the tip before the tooltip (test_slint_elided)
a section header name longer than the room before its chip: name-elided puts the name in the tip before the tooltip (test_slint_elided)
a slider lane's caption squeezed by the lane's readout: caption-elided puts the caption in the slider's tip before the host's tooltip (not exercised by a hover test - the same TipTimer rule)
a field's placeholder longer than the field: placeholder-elided puts the placeholder in the field's tip while the field is empty (not exercised by a hover test - the same TipTimer rule)

ElidedHint (the strip's hint lines, the counter plate's caption, the age axis, and the row labels of the SYSTEM, SIGNAL and EXTEND banks, which inherit it): the component's own tip says the whole text when it is elided (test_slint_elided)

a choice's words (a RadioChoice of lane K's row panel: the colour sets, the number format, the detector) longer than the 254 px column: the row passes the option's own words as the tooltip (KPanel: tooltip: r.note != "" ? r.note : o); not exercised by a hover test - the same TipTimer rule as the other elided labels
